title: •_Punishing One_
caption: •_Punishing One_ (V)
game_text: May add 1 alien pilot and 1 passenger. During battle here, while Dengar piloting, attrition against opponent is +3. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Old Corellian Engineering Corporation starfighter. Has outdated Class Three hyperdrive, but high sublight speed capability. Easy to maintain. Owned by Dengar.

notes: Unique. 'Punishing One' italic in the slip's title line and caption (marked _…_ as vs5/39). Banner STARFIGHTER: CORELLIAN JM 5000. Stats POWER 2 / MANEUVER 5 / HYPERSPEED 3; deploy 2 / forfeit 4. Scomp-link ring → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: independent, nav. Slip text matches the stub. The wiki's default 'Punishing One' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Punishing One (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Dagobah-D-punishingone.gif is the Errata face — downloaded to src/vs5/46-Dagobah-D-punishingone.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore matches both scans. Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 face. Modern: V7-D-punishingone.gif (745 px, the Virtual Set 7 remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
